heroSubtext: Saucy Fields is a two-person print shop in Winona, MN. We draw, design, and screen-print shirts and posters for bands, businesses, and anyone who wants something better than clip art — and sell a few of our own along the way.
heroImageAlt: Isaac and Spencer of Saucy Fields against a mustard-yellow backdrop

whatWeDo.title: Draw it
whatWeDo.body: Hand-drawn artwork made for your band, your business, or your one-off idea. No clip art, no templates.

whatWeDo.title: Print it
whatWeDo.body: Screen-printed shirts and posters, pulled in small runs so the quality stays high and the box stays light.

whatWeDo.title: Move it
whatWeDo.body: We can hold your stock, sell it here on the site, ship it out, or hand it off in person. Whatever’s easiest.
